title: Patch 1.0.17
intro: A small bug fixing patch for today, vikings!
bullets: Fixed a rare bug that could erase all objects in parts of the world when one large world save chunk file was split into smaller ones.

Fixed invalid item types (most importantly invalid shield of root variant that was available in 1.0.15 on PlayStation®5) causing buggy behaviour. Now invalid styles just reset to the default style and continue functioning normally.
wa_text:
📜 *Patch Notes — Patch 1.0.17*
_A small bug fixing patch for today, vikings!_

• Fixed a rare bug that could erase all objects in parts of the world when one large world save chunk file was split into smaller ones.
• Fixed invalid item types (most importantly invalid shield of root variant that was available in 1.0.15 on PlayStation®5) causing buggy behaviour. Now invalid styles just reset to the default style and continue functioning normally.
• Updated some placeholder text.
• Fixed credits being hidden in 1.0.16.

🔗 *Full Notes:* https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/892970/view/1845383656396226
